# Gyata.ai

> > AI-powered learning platform that transforms YouTube videos into interactive courses across programming languages (Python, C++, PHP, JavaScript), frameworks (Laravel, Angular, React, Django), and cloud technologies (AWS).

Gyata.ai offers a comprehensive catalog of AI-generated courses and learning paths covering web development, data science, artificial intelligence, and software engineering. The platform features both free and premium subscription tiers for accessing structured educational content.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered course generation
- Python programming
- C++ development
- Laravel framework
- HTML5 & web development
- PHP tutorials
- Angular & React
- Node.js & TypeScript
- AWS cloud services
- MongoDB & SQL databases
- Object-oriented programming
- RESTful API design
- SEO optimization
- WordPress development
- Learning paths & skill categories

## Getting Started

- [Gyata.Ai - Learn Any Topic](https://gyata.ai): Homepage: Turn YouTube videos into interactive AI-powered courses
- [Gyata | About Us](https://gyata.ai/about-us): Company overview: AI tools for content creation, education & learning
- [Gyata | Pricing](https://gyata.ai/pricing): AI course creation pricing: Basic (free), Standard ($4.99), Premium ($9.99)
- [Gyata | Contact Us](https://gyata.ai/contact-us): Contact form, email (hr@gyata.ai), New Delhi location & business hours

- [Artificial Intelligence Courses](https://gyata.ai/artificial-intelligence): AI course collection with tutorials from Edureka, Simplilearn & others

## Web Development Tutorials

- [HTML Basics: Understanding and Mastering HTML5](https://gyata.ai/html/html-basics): HTML5 fundamentals: document structure, tags & web development basics
- [HTML5 Basics: An Introduction to HTML Tutorial](https://gyata.ai/html/html-introduction): Beginner HTML5 tutorial: markup language basics & web page structure

- [Mastering PHP Graphics](https://gyata.ai/php/basic-graphics-concepts): PHP GD library tutorial: drawing lines, shapes & image manipulation

## Laravel Framework Guides

- [Manually Authenticating Users in Laravel](https://gyata.ai/laravel/manually-authenticating-users): Laravel manual authentication guide: user login & security implementation
